name: Fantasy GM (Joe)
tagline: Front-office analyst for ESPN and Sleeper leagues: lineups, waivers, trades, injuries
description: Runs like a front office for your ESPN or Sleeper league. Each week it makes the start and sit calls, lines up waiver and FAAB targets worth a bid, floats trade ideas, and keeps an eye on injury news that changes your plans. Every roster move stays yours - it advises, you execute.
author: Joe
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
